property.name: useConsole
property.shortdesc: If true, output is going to a console window.

property.name: useStructuredEventHandler
property.shortdesc: If true, install structured event handler.

property.name: sendCrashLogs
property.shortdesc: If true, send crash log data to Adobe.

property.name: useEventLog
property.shortdesc: If true, output is redirected to the system event log.

property.name: iorFile
property.shortdesc: Location to write the IOR file for CORBA.

property.name: pluginPaths
property.shortdesc: Additional paths from which to load plugins.

property.name: port
property.shortdesc: The socket the server uses to service SOAP requests.

property.name: configuration
property.shortdesc: The configuration name for this instance of the server.

property.name: onMainThreadOnly
property.shortdesc: If true, client requests are executed on main thread only.

property.name: sessionSupportLoggingEnabled
property.shortdesc: If true, session support logging is enabled.

property.name: sessionTimeout
property.shortdesc: The session timeout (in seconds) for soap sessions.

property.name: adminPort
property.shortdesc: The socket the server uses to service administrative requests.

property.name: hostName
property.shortdesc: The name of the machine InDesignServer is running on; either symbolic (host.corp.com) or IP address (123.345.678.90).

property.name: heartbeatUpdateInterval
property.shortdesc: The time interval (in seconds) at which last active timestamp of IDS is updated to IDS console app.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the ServerSetting (a Application).

property.name: events
property.shortdesc: A collection of events.

property.name: eventListeners
property.shortdesc: A collection of event listeners.

property.name: useErrorList
property.shortdesc: If true, errors are saved in the error list.

property.name: maximumErrors
property.shortdesc: Maximum number of errors to save.

property.name: imagePreview
property.shortdesc: If true, generates image previews.

property.name: javascriptUi
property.shortdesc: If true, makes the native JavaScript user interface available.

property.name: nonBlockingSessionSupport
property.shortdesc: If true, BeginSession requests are not blocked if no new session can be started currently (for cases when server is busy).

property.name: sessionSupportMaxWait
property.shortdesc: The maximum time (in seconds) for which client wants to wait for BeginSession request to be serviced.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the ServerSetting.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
